articles.title: Gnosis Pay breach exposes card numbers, home addresses and linked crypto wallets
articles.snippet: One user said the exposed data tied his home address and card number to every crypto wallet linked to his account, raising the risk of targeted scams.

articles.title: Crypto Card Provider Gnosis Pay Says Hackers Accessed Customer Data
articles.snippet: Gnosis Pay said hackers accessed customer information on the legacy system behind its branded cards, though funds weren’t affected and its enterprise card platform was untouched.
